text:
mira: Quick sync 1 Optimize Toolkit pilots. Can we lock a minimal alpha acceptance set so sales can sign? Need numbers by EOD Fri.

sam: From eng: keep it non-destructive (suggestions only). Deliver: 1) batching recommendations API (expected p50/p95 deltas + token cost delta), 2) prefix-cache suggestion + measurement endpoint (estimate prefix hit rate), 3) quantization report endpoint (named metric delta + throughput uplift), 4) eval-alert adapter that emits webhook/Slack/email when chosen metric regresses past a threshold. No auto-apply.

leo: I'll produce a compact model compatibility table and quick bench for 3 common models. Will flag any models we must not recommend for quant.

anya: CS asks each rec include a one-line rationale and a confidence label (low/med/high). Pilot customers require a manual accept toggle in the UI.

rafa: Ops/SRE: pilots must include a canary route + automatic fallback to hosted inference if p95 or error rate crosses configured SLOs. We also need a one-page runbook for rollback and SRE contact.

sam: Minimal smoke example we can give customers:
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/optimize/suggest \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \ 
  -d '{"route":"checkout-chat","seq_len":256,"model":"redwood-mx-7b"}'
Expect small JSON with keys: batching, cache, quant_report, explanation, confidence, measurement_endpoint. Keep responses machine-readable.

mira: Proposed numeric gates to negotiate: primary quality metric drop <=1.5% during pilot; token cost reduction >=10% OR p50 latency improvement >=10% for a recommendation to be "value-add"; eval-alert default threshold = 5% regression.

leo: For quant_report include the metric name (e.g., F1 / ROUGE-L), sample size, and a noise flag when results are unreliable.

anya: CS pilot acceptance checklist (short): 1) onboarding doc + runbook, 2) 2-week pilot dashboard showing baseline vs pilot, 3) weekly checkpoints, 4) rollback tested, 5) SRE signoff on fallback.

sam: Rough ETA if parallel: rec APIs + measurement endpoint = 3w, quant bench + comp table = 2w, eval-alert adapter = 1.5w, dashboard stub + accept toggle = 1.5w -> target ~4-5w alpha.

ops-bot: ops-bot: reserved tentative pilot deploy window 2024-06-22 01:30 UTC.

mira: OK locking minimal alpha scope to the above (recommendation-only APIs, measurement endpoints, eval-alerts -> webhook/Slack/email, dashboard stub with manual accept/rollback, runbook). Please react with :thumbsup: if you can deliver or list blockers.
